ImageDescription.value: Winter view of Sakrisøy, a small island village in the Lofoten archipelago, Nordland County, Norway. Traditional orange fishermen’s cabins stand on wooden stilts above the turquoise fjord, with scattered houses along the shore. Dramatic snow-covered mountains rise steeply behind the settlement, under a pastel evening sky that adds to the Arctic coastal atmosphere.
